name: The Ice Cave Signal
description: Under the ice of an outer moon, something has been transmitting a prime-number sequence for longer than your species has existed. The survey drill broke into a hall: smooth walls, glyphs that glow when you look at them, and a sealed vault. The readings behind its door are exotic matter, refined. Take a team down, learn what you can, and open the vault.

triggers.title: The Hall of Glyphs
triggers.text: Walls smoother than anything your fabricators can make. Three alcoves glow: north, north-east and south. The glyphs in them pulse in the same prime sequence as the signal. At the end of the hall a door of black lattice hums.

triggers.title: The First Glyph
triggers.text: A pillar of clear ice with a glyph suspended in it, rotating slowly. The pattern looks almost like a counting system.

choices.label: Work out the count
choices.text: Base seven. The pillar dims, satisfied. Your instruments record everything.
choices.fail_text: You get it wrong. Somewhere in the north alcove, a crystal turns to look at you.

choices.label: Photograph it and move on
choices.text: The labs can puzzle over it.

triggers.title: The Second Glyph
triggers.text: This glyph is a map. Nine circles round a point of light: your sun. A tenth circle, far out, is marked twice.

choices.label: Trace the tenth circle
choices.text: Coordinates. The jump points at the edge of your system, marked by someone who used them.
choices.fail_text: The glyph flares and every lattice in the vault wakes up and waits.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: You have what you came for. Almost.

triggers.title: The Third Glyph
triggers.text: No pattern this time: a sound, too low to hear, felt in the teeth. It wants the squad to stand still and listen together.

choices.label: Hold the squad still and listen
choices.text: Four heartbeats fall into step with the hum. The ice seems to lean towards you. You feel attuned.
choices.fail_text: Someone shifts, someone coughs. The hum turns into a whine and something detaches from the south wall.

choices.label: Don't touch it
choices.text: Some things are better left humming.

triggers.title: The Harmonic Lock
triggers.text: The vault door is a lattice of black glass, and it sings the prime sequence. Behind it you can see a vast figure of stone and gold, kneeling, and the cold violet glow of refined exotic matter.

choices.label: Sing the sequence back
choices.text: The lattice opens like a flower. The guardian lifts its head, sees you, and does not rise at once. The violet glow pours over the squad.
choices.fail_text: A wrong note. The guardian stands up.

choices.label: Cut through it
choices.text: Plasma torches on ancient glass. The guardian stands up.

triggers.title: The Ice Shifts
triggers.text: A boom deep in the moon. Behind you, two sentinels slide out of the wall where the drill came in.

loot.text: A shard of lattice glass, humming faintly.
A sliver of refined exotic matter in a glass vial.
Survey gear the drill team left behind.
The vault's store: violet crystals that bend light.
The guardian's glyph core, for the labs.
